qwen-3.6-35b-a3b.name: Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B

hybrid_attention.block_pattern: 10 x [3 x (Gated DeltaNet linear attention -> MoE) -> 1 x (Gated Attention -> MoE)]

qwen-3.6-35b-a3b.notes: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B sparse MoE with hybrid attention. 40 layers total: 30 layers Gated DeltaNet (linear attention with fixed recurrent state matrix 32 heads x 128 x 128 in FP32) and 10 layers standard Gated Attention (2 KV heads, head dim 256 in FP16). Parameter categories: 35.0B total stored weights = 32.2B routed (40 layers x 256 experts x 3.15M params/expert) + 2.8B non-routed shared pool (1.43B text backbone + 0.51B embedding table + 0.51B untied LM head + 0.35B vision tower / multimodal weights; published vision tower ~0.41B falls within 0.08B rounding tolerance). Active compute reconciliation: in text-only inference, active parameters are 2.94B ~ 3.0B (1.43B backbone + 1.01B routed + 0.51B output LM head), matching the official 'A3B' designation. Sparse input embedding lookup is an O(1) table gather (0 GEMM FLOPs), and the vision tower is conditional multimodal-only (0 FLOPs for text). Decode weight streaming: only 1.94B shared weights (1.43B backbone + 0.51B output head) plus active routed experts are streamed per step; the embedding table is accessed via sparse lookup and vision weights are strictly excluded from text decode streaming. All 35.0B parameters remain resident in accelerator memory (19.688 GB footprint).
